source_title: Vandemon Titanium Full Exhaust System for Kawasaki Ninja H2 SX
description: With the legendary release of the H2/H2R in 2015, Vandemon chose not to re-invent the wheel but replicate as close to perfect the same beautiful… • Material: Ti1 Brushed Titanium. • Muffler: Ti1 Brushed Titanium & Carbon Fibre Tip. • Production year: 2018. • Power: + 8hp or 12hp with H2R Muffler.
source_description_html:
With the legendary release of the H2/H2R in 2015, Vandemon chose not to re-invent the wheel but replicate as close to perfect the same beautiful Titanium Exhaust adorned on the race version H2R.

Now with the addition of the SE/SX to the H2 family, a new approach was required which would compliment Kawasaki's new hyper tourer, so we set about creating another titanium masterpiece which would complement the latest addition to the H2 range.

Headers had to be re-designed entirely to accommodate round exhaust ports, and the challenge was to use tighter radius bends to squeeze the headers into the bodywork so to achieve much-needed clearance from fairings. The muffler also required a whole new approach compared to the H2R slash cut style muffler, due to the panniers proximity to exhaust gases. So we set about designing a muffler that would direct the exiting gases away from the pannier as well as offer a moderate increase in sound over the OEM exhaust'' and look great with bags on or off! And we think we came up with something extraordinary, an exhaust that significantly reduces weight, enhances the sound and appearance and importantly performance.

  • Material: Ti1 Brushed Titanium
  • Muffler: Ti1 Brushed Titanium & Carbon Fibre Tip 
  • Optional H2R Muffler (Not Pannier Compatible)
  • Production year: 2018
  • Power: + 8hp or 12hp with H2R Muffler
  • Weight: Total 5.5kg ( OEM Exhaust System 14.1kg )
  • Noise: 105 Db at 5500rpm ( H2R muffler 105Db baffle in) 
  • 12 x 1.25 & 18 x 1.5mm O2 sensor provision 
  • Application: Road and Track

description: This muffler can be used in conjunction with the OEM Kawasaki Exhaust headers with a catalytic converter or the Vandemon Titanium headers. • Material: Ti1 Brushed Titanium. • Muffler: Ti1 Brushed Titanium & Carbon Fibre Tip. • Power: Stock + 8hp. • Weight: Total 2.4kg ( OEM Muffler 6kg ).
source_description_html:
This muffler can be used in conjunction with the OEM Kawasaki Exhaust headers with a catalytic converter or the Vandemon Titanium headers.

The Vandemon H2 SE/SX muffler has been specially designed to be compatible with the OEM panniers and still be compact and not look bulky, with bags on or off! As a result, we think we came up with something extraordinary, a muffler that significantly reduces weight and enhances sound and, importantly, performance.

  • Material: Ti1 Brushed Titanium
  • Muffler: Ti1 Brushed Titanium & Carbon Fibre Tip 
  • Power: Stock + 8hp 
  • Weight: Total 2.4kg ( OEM Muffler 6kg )
  • Noise: 105 Db at 5500rpm ( No Baffled option supplied) 
  • Application: Road and Race

Our exhausts are professionally packaged to prevent damage in transit and arrive in a natural brushed finish that transforms to an iridescent blue, purple & gold colour beginning at the engine headers after only one heat cycle.


WHY BUY A TITANIUM EXHAUST?

Due to its strength, weight and corrosion quality, Titanium is found in the most demanding applications.

  • Aircraft airframes
  • Jet engine compressor blades and ducting
  • Deep-sea saltwater vessels
  • Steam turbine blades
  • Rocket motor cases
  • F1 and MotoGP


OTHER ADVANTAGES OF TITANIUM:

  • Very light, Increased power too weight ratio
  • Won't corrode or change colour from exposure to water
  • Never need polishing like stainless steel & aluminium
  • Dissipates heat twice as fast as stainless steel
  • Won't distort or oxidise at high temperatures

 

TUNING

There is no requirement to tune the engine to suit, but for best results, we recommended re-fuelling.

name: Vandemon Stealth Bimodal Quattro Titanium Exhaust System for Ducati Diavel V4
source_title: Vandemon Stealth Bimodal Quattro Titanium Exhaust System for Ducati Diavel V4
description: Choose from two exhaust tones at the Press of a button • All Ti1 Titanium Headers, Link Pipe Muffler & Valve. • Ti1 Titanium Muffler Tips x 4. • Weather-resistant BMW Servo driver. • Carbon Fibre Heat Shield supplied.
source_description_html:
Choose from two exhaust tones at the Press of a button

Vandemon has introduced the Diavel V4 to our Stealth exhaust catalogue in response to increasingly stringent global regulations and heightened public scrutiny. The entire exhaust system is constructed from lightweight, exotic Ti1 Titanium, reducing weight by 9.8kg. Additionally, we have incorporated a Bimodal variable muffler that allows you to switch between quiet operation and straight-through unrestricted exhaust, providing an unimpeded flow for maximum power and exceptional sound through four straight-through outlets. This exhaust system replaces the OEM steel mufflers, resulting in significant weight reduction and eliminating heat stress for riders in summer caused by heat emanating from the exhaust when stationary. 

Tuning 

Custom tuning is required as we do not provide a tune with our exhaust systems. You will need to employ a technician, preferably with a dynamometer, who will customize the tune for the open valve (loud mode), which will work fine in quiet (Stealth mode) also. Stealth mode should only be used when highway cruising or in suburban and city areas, at lower engine speeds and not when racing. The exhaust is designed to provide both performance and a quieter option, so the rider can choose between the two by pressing a button."

Vandemon exhaust systems are designed to deliver peak performance, style, and an impressive sound. They are crafted using advanced manufacturing techniques and high-quality materials like Titanium, resulting in a much lighter exhaust system with lower heat retention compared to the standard OEM system. The weld quality is exceptional, featuring ultrasonically perfect welds that are expected and appreciated by Ducati customers for such an iconic motorcycle brand that only enhances this outstanding marque.

Appearance:
"The surface finish is a natural brushed finish. When heated, it changes to an iridescent blue and red. Titanium has an advantage over stainless steel because it won't stain, corrode, or ever need polishing. This is due to Titanium's high acid and salt resistance, which also allows it to dissipate heat twice as fast as steel. This further safeguards against extended heat soak into body panels when stationary."

Manufacture:
We at Vandemon utilize a unique welding process that fully penetrates and creates an ultrasonically perfect connection at all joints with a distinct flush finish.

Tuning:

Custom tuning is recommended for the best results and to prevent a lean A/F ratio.

All mounting hardware supplied

Technical Specs

  • All Ti1 Titanium Headers, Link Pipe Muffler & Valve
  • Ti1 Titanium Muffler Tips x 4
  • Weather-resistant BMW Servo driver 
  • Carbon Fibre Heat Shield supplied 
  • Total Weight 5.1kg (OEM 14.9kg), saving 9.8kg
  • Power +13hp & +14n/m After custom Dyno Tune 
  • Noise: Stealth Mode 96Db or Valve Open 105Db @ 5500RPM 
  • Custom Tuning required
  • Not Euro-4/5 compliant for emissions 

Why buy a titanium exhaust?

Due to its strength, weight and anti-corrosion quality, Titanium is found in the most demanding applications on Aircraft airframes, jet engine compressor blades and ducting, deep-sea saltwater vessels, steam turbine blades, rocket motor cases and F1 and MotoGP

Other advantages of Titanium:

  • Very light, Increased power too weight ratio
  • Won't corrode or discolour
  • Never need polishing like stainless steel & aluminium
  • Dissipate Heat twice as fast as Stainless Steel
